title: View details opens one panel under the tile's row, pointing at the tile
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Note that no tile shows a detail panel (if one does, click its View details to close it).
  3. Click View details on the Revenue tile.
  4. Look at where the detail opens and at the Revenue tile's footer.
  5. Click View details on the Technician Efficiency tile.
  6. Look at the page again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Revenue chart opens in one full-width panel directly under the top row of tiles, with a small pointer on the panel's top edge under the Revenue tile. The Revenue tile is outlined and its footer reads View details with an upward arrow. The other tiles stay where they are.
  • Opening Technician Efficiency closes the Revenue panel and opens the Technician Efficiency chart and table in the same place, now pointing at the Technician Efficiency tile. Only one panel is ever open.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12. Moved here from C88629 (one-panel layout). Also PRD Story 6. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 04_Revenue_After and 06_TechEff_After (panel under the row, pointing back at its card).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R2: “Expanding a tile reveals that tile's detail content — its chart, its detail table, or both.”
  • S6-R10: “When the user expands a tile while another tile's detail is open, the previously open detail closes.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
